_comment: Fixed Swahili phrases the app speaks. Each one is rendered ahead of time with QVAC Chatterbox (scripts/phrases/generate.mjs) and shipped as assets/phrases/sw/<id>.m4a. `en` is the English line shown under the Swahili, never spoken. Edit here, then regenerate.

aim_open.sw: Elekeza simu kwenye lebo, kisha gusa skrini.
aim_open.en: Point the phone at the label, then tap the screen.

camera_permission.en: Allow the camera so I can read.

hint_left.en: Move a little to the left.

hint_right.en: Move a little to the right.

hint_unclear.sw: Picha haiko wazi. Shikilia simu bila kutikisa, mahali penye mwanga.
hint_unclear.en: The photo isn't clear. Hold the phone still, somewhere with more light.

hint_no_text.sw: Sijaona maandishi. Elekeza simu kwenye lebo mahali penye mwanga, kisha gusa tena.
hint_no_text.en: I didn't see any writing. Point the phone at the label in good light, then tap again.

line_unsure.sw: Mstari huu sijaweza kuusoma vizuri. Muulize mfamasia.
line_unsure.en: I couldn't read this line clearly. Ask the pharmacist.

line_swahili.sw: Mstari wa Kiswahili uko kwenye skrini. Siwezi kuusoma kwa sauti bado.
line_swahili.en: A Swahili line is on the screen. I can't read it aloud yet.

not_sure.sw: Sijaweza kusoma vizuri. Sitakisia dozi. Muulize mfamasia au daktari.
not_sure.en: I couldn't read this clearly. I won't guess a dose. Ask your pharmacist or doctor.

try_again_light.sw: Jaribu tena mahali penye mwanga zaidi.
try_again_light.en: Try again somewhere with more light.

error.en: Sorry, something went wrong. Try again.
